svg.title: What to do when a tile says Sign in again
svg.desc: When every saved account says it at once, look for an update of the extension first. Otherwise, an account that signs in with Google or Apple, or one without a remembered password, chooses Add account and signs in once on Autodarts as that player; the same tile is ready again. An account with an Autodarts password can instead remember its password and tap the tile, and the extension signs it in by itself. When it remembers a password already, that password no longer works: forget it and remember the new one.
